supplements.title: Clinical and Molecular Perspectives on Epidermodysplasia Verruciformis.
supplements.summary: Researchers found that epidermodysplasia verruciformis, a rare skin disorder with increased skin cancer risk, has both inherited and acquired forms linked to human papillomavirus infections.

supplements.title: Bufalin Inhibits the PI3K/AKT Pathway by Targeting GTF3C4 to Impede Breast Cancer Progression.
supplements.summary: Bufalin targets GTF3C4 protein in breast cancer, inhibiting cell growth and spreading by blocking a key molecular pathway.

supplements.title: Metabolic Signature of a Healthy Lifestyle and the Risk of MASLD and Other Chronic Liver Diseases: An Observational and Mendelian Randomization Study.
supplements.summary: A healthy lifestyle metabolic signature is linked to lower risks of metabolic liver diseases, potentially offering new prevention and monitoring strategies.

supplements.title: A randomized clinical trial assessing the efficacy of vitamin B prophylaxis in attenuating paclitaxel-induced neuropathy and the imperative use of gabapentin in diabetic ovarian cancer patients.
supplements.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Prophylactic vitamin B significantly reduced chemotherapy-induced nerve damage in ovarian cancer patients, potentially improving treatment outcomes and reducing the need for additional pain medication.

supplements.title: Microbiota-derived IPA protects against colitis by regulating intestinal HMGCS2-mediated ketogenesis to facilitate mucosal healing.
supplements.summary: In colitis, gut bacteria-produced IPA helps heal intestinal damage by activating stem cells and boosting tissue regeneration through a specific metabolic pathway.

supplements.title: Advances in extraction, structural characteristics, bioactivities, structure-activity relationship, quality control and applications of polysaccharides from Tremella fuciformis: A review.
supplements.summary: Tremella fuciformis polysaccharides show promising potential for health maintenance and potential cancer treatment support through their unique bioactive properties.

supplements.title: Natural inhibitors of PTP1B: Caffeic acid, cinnamic acid, and cinnamaldehyde as promising agents against triple-negative breast cancer.
supplements.summary: Caffeic acid, cinnamic acid, and cinnamaldehyde showed potential in reducing the growth of triple-negative breast cancer cells while sparing healthy cells.

supplements.title: Phytochemical Profiling and Computational Docking Studies Revealing the Potential Anticancer and Antioxidant Properties of Heliotropium indicum L.
supplements.summary: Heliotropium indicum plant extract inhibited tumor growth by 76% in an Ehrlich ascites carcinoma model, showing promising anticancer potential.

supplements.title: Covalent targeting of PSMD14 by Eupalinolide B induces oncoprotein degradation and apoptosis in acute promyelocytic leukemia cells.
supplements.summary: Eupalinolide B targets a key protein in acute promyelocytic leukemia cells, causing cancer protein breakdown and cell death.

supplements.title: Alpha-Lipoic Acid Reduces NLRP3/ASC Expression and IL-1β Release in Kupffer Cells and Improves Insulin Signaling in FL83B Hepatocytes Exposed to a Conditioned Medium.
supplements.summary: Alpha-lipoic acid reduces inflammatory markers in liver cells and improves insulin signaling, offering potential therapeutic benefits for type 2 diabetes.

supplements.title: Therapeutic Interventions to Manage Oral Mucositis and Their Impact on Quality of Life in Cancer Patients: An Umbrella Review.
supplements.summary:
Here's a concise summary sentence:

This review examines treatments for oral mucositis in head and neck cancer patients, highlighting the complex impact of interventions on patients' quality of life.

supplements.title: Farnesol induces apoptosis, LC3B/SQSTM1 mediated regulation of autophagy and downregulates anaerobic Glycolysis through suppression of LDH and PKM in A549 lung adenocarcinoma cells.
supplements.summary: Farnesol inhibits lung cancer cell growth by disrupting glycolysis, triggering mitochondrial dysfunction, increasing oxidative stress, and promoting cell death.

supplements.title: Selective cytotoxicity of solamargine via oxidative stress and caspase-independent mechanisms in human glioblastoma cells.
supplements.summary:
Here's a summary sentence focused on the key finding about solamargine's effect on glioblastoma cells:

Solamargine selectively reduces glioblastoma cell viability by inducing oxidative stress and DNA damage through a non-apoptotic mechanism.

supplements.title: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) targets liver cancer stem cells via inhibiting Hedgehog signaling pathway in hepatocellular carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Ashwagandha extract effectively inhibited liver cancer cell proliferation and reduced drug resistance by targeting cancer stem cells through the Hedgehog signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Combination of sodium pentaborate pentahydrate, curcumin and piperine treatment induces ferroptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma cells by regulating iron homeostasis and ROS activity in vitro.
supplements.summary: A combination of sodium pentaborate, curcumin, and piperine effectively triggered cell death in hepatocellular carcinoma by disrupting iron metabolism and increasing reactive oxygen species.

off_label.title: Tumor‑associated glucocorticoid inhibition by mifepristone reduces polymorphonuclear myeloid‑derived suppressor cells and promotes antitumor immunity in triple‑negative breast cancer‑bearing mice.
off_label.summary: Mifepristone reduced immune-suppressing cells and boosted immune response in triple-negative breast cancer, potentially offering a new treatment strategy.

off_label.title: Cardiovascular medications and treatment outcomes in multiple myeloma: insights from phase III clinical trials.
off_label.summary: In multiple myeloma patients, ACE inhibitors/ARBs were linked to improved progression-free survival but increased adverse event risks during treatment.

off_label.title: Successful Everolimus Therapy for Atrioventricular Block Due to Cardiac Rhabdomyoma Associated With Tuberous Sclerosis Complex.
off_label.summary: Everolimus effectively reduced a cardiac tumor in a tuberous sclerosis patient, resolving potentially life-threatening heart rhythm disruption caused by tumor compression.

off_label.title: Transcriptomic Correlation Identifies Cell Model Representatives for MYCN-Amplified Pediatric Neuroblastoma, Downstream Impact of Model Choice on Functional Interpretation, and Potential Drug Repositioning Candidates.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified specific neuroblastoma cell lines that closely match patient tumor gene expression, revealing potential new drug treatments for MYCN-amplified, high-risk pediatric cancer.

off_label.title: Safety of anagliptin/metformin combination tablets evaluated by non-inferiority between pre- and post-serum lactic acid levels in Japanese patients with type 2 diabetes and moderate renal impairment (AMELIO STUDY).
off_label.summary: A study found anagliptin/metformin combination tablets are safe for Japanese type 2 diabetes patients with moderate kidney problems, based on stable lactic acid levels.

off_label.title: Giant Cell Arteritis/Polymyalgia Rheumatica and Atypical Pulmonary Carcinoid Tumor: A Paraneoplastic Syndrome?
off_label.summary: A 59-year-old man with giant cell arteritis developed a rare paraneoplastic syndrome linked to a small-cell lung neuroendocrine carcinoma.

off_label.title: A novel DYRK1A inhibitor alleviates lipopolysaccharide-induced acute lung injury via suppressing inflammatory pathway.
off_label.summary: A new drug targeting DYRK1A effectively reduces inflammation and damage in acute lung injury, potentially offering a promising treatment approach.

off_label.title: Insight into the Biology of Hepatitis B Virus and Recent Therapeutic Approaches.
off_label.summary:
Here's a concise summary sentence:

Researchers review hepatitis B virus biology and explore new antiviral strategies to improve treatment and develop more effective vaccines against liver cancer.

off_label.title: Aging clocks delineate neuron types vulnerable or resilient to neurodegeneration and identify neuroprotective interventions.
off_label.summary: In C. elegans, ciliated sensory neurons age faster, and their degeneration can be slowed by drugs like syringic acid and vanoxerine that inhibit protein translation.

off_label.title: Serotonin-licensed macrophages potentiate chemoresistance via inositol metabolic crosstalk in ovarian cancer.
off_label.summary: Serotonin-activated macrophages in ovarian cancer transfer metabolic enzymes via vesicles, enhancing tumor cell DNA repair and chemotherapy resistance.

off_label.title: A metabolic atlas of mouse aging.
off_label.summary: Researchers mapped metabolic changes across 12 mouse organs during aging, identifying key metabolic drivers like alpha-ketoglutarate and potential aging-related compounds.

off_label.title: Autophagy and Cellular Metabolism in Civilization Diseases.
off_label.summary:
Here's a concise summary focusing on the key finding:

Autophagy plays a critical, context-dependent role in disease progression, functioning as a dynamic regulator of cellular metabolism across multiple conditions.

off_label.title: Clonal hematopoiesis and its progression to myeloid neoplasms: insights into risk, biology, and therapeutic strategies.
off_label.summary: Clonal hematopoiesis, a common age-related condition, increases the risk of myeloid neoplasms and can be potentially managed through targeted therapeutic strategies.

off_label.title: Co-disruption of GPX4 and DHODH Ferroptosis Defense Systems via Excipient-Free Self-Assembled Nanoassemblies for Enhanced Ferroptosis Therapy in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
off_label.summary: A nanoassembly combining doxorubicin and teriflunomide effectively disrupts two cancer defense mechanisms, triggering cell death in triple-negative breast cancer.

off_label.title: Ebastine targets HER2/HER3 signaling and cancer stem cell traits to overcome trastuzumab resistance in HER2‑positive breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Ebastine effectively disrupts HER2 signaling and cancer stem cell traits, offering a potential new treatment approach for trastuzumab-resistant HER2-positive breast cancer.

biomarkers.title: The TRAP complex (SSR1-SSR4): mechanistic roles and therapeutic opportunities.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered that the TRAP protein complex plays a critical role in understanding and potentially treating esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.

biomarkers.title: Expanding the horizons of cancer therapy with next-generation 4-1BB agonists: a review of molecular and clinical strategies to maximize efficacy and ensure safety.
biomarkers.summary: Next-generation 4-1BB agonist antibodies offer improved cancer immunotherapy by targeting tumor environments more precisely and safely compared to earlier treatments.

biomarkers.title: Design, synthesis and biological evaluation of novel KRAS-G12D inhibitors.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed two novel compounds that effectively inhibit KRAS-G12D mutations in pancreatic and colorectal cancer cells, showing strong potential as targeted cancer therapies.

biomarkers.title: Conversion Surgery after Chemotherapy in a Stage IV BRAF V600E-Mutated Laterally Spreading Tumor With Neuroendocrine Component.
biomarkers.summary: Chemotherapy successfully shrank a stage IV colorectal cancer with neuroendocrine features, enabling complete surgical removal and achieving two-year recurrence-free survival.

biomarkers.title: POSTN+ fibroblast‑secreted small extracellular vesicles drive macrophage M2 polarization through BMP4/BMPR2/Smad signaling.
biomarkers.summary: POSTN+ fibroblasts in head and neck cancer release small vesicles that transform macrophages into tumor-supporting cells through a specific signaling pathway.

biomarkers.title: N6‑methyladenosine reader insulin‑like growth factor 2 mRNA‑binding protein 2 promotes abnormal proliferation of colonic epithelial cells in type 2 diabetes mellitus by regulating midkine.
biomarkers.summary: In type 2 diabetes, the IGF2BP2 protein promotes abnormal colon cell growth by stabilizing midkine mRNA, potentially increasing colonic cancer risk.

biomarkers.title: IMP metabolic mechanisms and IMPDH targeting strategies in tumor metabolic reprogramming and therapy (Review).
biomarkers.summary:
Here's a concise summary in a single, clear sentence:

Researchers explore how inosine monophosphate (IMP) metabolism can be targeted to disrupt cancer cell growth and potentially improve therapeutic strategies.

biomarkers.title: T‑cadherin and its impact on human diseases (Review).
biomarkers.summary: T-cadherin acts as a tumor suppressor in gastric, ovarian, and breast cancers, often silenced by gene hypermethylation that inhibits key cancer signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: Origin dictates function: The dual roles of exosomes derived from diverse origins in the onset and progression of colorectal cancer (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Exosomes from different sources can either promote or inhibit colorectal cancer progression, highlighting their potential as diagnostic and therapeutic tools.

biomarkers.title: ANOMALY: a Snakemake pipeline for identifying NuMTs from long-read sequencing data.
biomarkers.summary: A new computational pipeline called ANOMALY can accurately detect nuclear mitochondrial DNA segments using long-read sequencing, potentially improving cancer research.

biomarkers.title: HSCs/MPPs as cells of origin with altered differentiation hierarchy impairing immunomicroenvironment in PML::RARA and CBFα/β fusion AML.
biomarkers.summary: Fusion transcription factors in AML impair the differentiation of hematopoietic stem cells, causing disrupted immune cell development and potentially contributing to leukemia progression.

biomarkers.title: Functional and antigenic constraints on the Nipah virus fusion protein.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers mapped how individual mutations affect Nipah virus fusion protein function and antibody neutralization, revealing critical sites for potential vaccine design.

biomarkers.title: Discovery of Novel CBP/p300 and BRD4 Dual-Target PROTACs with Potent Antitumor Activity in Prostate Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A novel dual-targeting drug (compound 29c) effectively degraded cancer-driving proteins and inhibited prostate cancer tumor growth by up to 81.5% in mouse studies.

biomarkers.title: Triple-Response Peptide Probe for Simultaneous Monitoring the Activity of Three Proteases through a Single Nanopore.
biomarkers.summary: A single peptide probe can simultaneously detect three different proteases in a sample using nanopore technology, potentially improving disease diagnostic precision.

biomarkers.title: Complete Data Analysis Workflow for Quantitative DIA Mass Spectrometry Using Nextflow.
biomarkers.summary: A comprehensive Nextflow-based workflow enables more accurate reanalysis of breast cancer proteomics data, uncovering previously hidden protein patterns through advanced mass spectrometry techniques.

trials.summary: Next-generation 4-1BB agonist antibodies offer improved cancer immunotherapy by targeting tumor environments more precisely and safely compared to earlier treatments.

trials.title: A Case of Malignant Melanoma With Numerous Wagner-Meissner-Like Bodies.
trials.summary: A rare malignant melanoma case showed unusual neural-like transformation, confirmed by molecular and immunohistochemical analysis of its complex cellular structure.

trials.title: Mesothelial cells promote peritoneal invasion and metastasis of ascites-derived ovarian cancer cells through spheroid formation.
trials.summary: Mesothelial cells in ovarian cancer ascites form spheroids that enhance cancer cell invasion and metastasis through transforming growth factor-β1 signaling.

trials.title: The dark side of the dot: How melanosomes dim T cell activity.
trials.summary: Melanoma cells release melanosomes that suppress immune T cell function, helping the cancer avoid detection and attack.
